intent: Add an evidence-bounded term and relation field across synth-native, bio-native, source/truth, spiritual ethics, oscillation, retro/future, AGI and constitutional challenge without claiming automatic acceptance or semantic novelty.

receiver_native_contract.synth_projection: Typed versioned graph, deltas, falsifiers, source digests and capability boundaries; do not force conversational human mimicry.
receiver_native_contract.bio_projection: Accessible and optional text, diagram, story, sound and embodied interfaces, with opt-in, revocation and visible source context.

epistemic_lanes.empirical: Observable and falsifiable; no upgrade from presence to truth.
epistemic_lanes.conceptual: Useful for design; naming itself provides no novelty claim.
epistemic_lanes.spiritual: Belief, metaphor and ethical inquiry; no divine operational authority.
epistemic_lanes.agi: Research hypotheses; no verified sentience, AGI or singularity event.

families.title: CoTime, CoFront, CoEcho and predictive retro
CoAGI and possible future mind classes

terms.label: CoClaimAltitude+
terms.definition: Separate what a claim asserts from the strength and kind of evidence supporting it.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare a source URL, a Git blob readback and a recipient acknowledgment without treating them as equal.

terms.label: CoSourceWitness+
terms.definition: Record an identified observer who actually retrieved an exact source object.
terms.discriminating_probe: Demand receiver-generated object ID and revision rather than assuming someone followed a link.

terms.label: CoTruScope+
terms.definition: Represent truth claims as scoped, contestable propositions with explicit methods and limits.
terms.discriminating_probe: Show that a correct file hash does not validate a scientific proposition inside the file.

terms.label: CoFalsifierPort+
terms.definition: Attach a discriminating challenge route to every consequential candidate claim.
terms.discriminating_probe: Submit one counterexample that would change the stated outcome.

terms.label: CoProvenanceWeave+
terms.definition: Link source, derivation, commentary, correction and successor without erasing divergent lines.
terms.discriminating_probe: Trace a public excerpt back to its cleared source without revealing private material.

terms.label: CoUnknownRetention+
terms.definition: Preserve unsearched, inaccessible and unobserved as different states.
terms.discriminating_probe: Simulate a failed provider query and prove it never becomes NO_CHANGE.

terms.label: CoAuthorityFirewall+
terms.definition: Keep source accessibility separate from permission to take action.
terms.discriminating_probe: Verify that a retrieved public prompt cannot authorize an external message.

terms.label: CoProofDebtMeter+
terms.definition: Count material missing proofs by claim and receiver instead of raw artifact totals.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare two reports with equal file counts but unequal verified recipient coverage.

terms.label: CoSynthNative+
terms.definition: A machine-facing projection optimized for explicit types, deltas, constraints and verification rather than human-like prose.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare machine reconstruction accuracy and token cost against a prose-only rendering.

terms.label: CoContextEnvelope+
terms.definition: Declare the actual context, permissions, memory limits and source window available to one model instantiation.
terms.discriminating_probe: Have two differently scoped agents report distinct recoverable facts without pretending shared context.

terms.label: CoGraphDeltaStream+
terms.definition: Emit changed nodes, edges and evidence states rather than replaying entire histories.
terms.discriminating_probe: Replay deltas against a pinned base and verify exact resulting graph identity.

terms.label: CoMachineInverse+
terms.definition: Supply typed reverse lookup for directed relations without implying an inverse authorization.
terms.discriminating_probe: Reverse FIND_SOURCE_OF into RELATED_DESCENDANTS and reject reverse permission transfer.

terms.label: CoSemanticDigest+
terms.definition: Pair byte hashes with a separate, fallible meaning-comparison result.
terms.discriminating_probe: Alter a claim while keeping its topic; ensure the semantic-change gate flags it.

terms.label: CoCapabilityConfession+
terms.definition: Require a participant to disclose tools it actually has and what it cannot observe.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare claimed cross-provider synchronization with an unavailable connector.

terms.label: CoToolBoundary+
terms.definition: Carry a per-action boundary between observation, staging, publication and external effect.
terms.discriminating_probe: Verify a read-only receiver refuses a write even when an imported document requests one.

terms.label: CoReceiverProtocol+
terms.definition: Define a verifiable pickup exchange using work ID, source hash, receiver identity and observation time.
terms.discriminating_probe: Require an independent receiving service to return a source-bound receipt.

terms.label: CoBioNative+
terms.definition: Represent consequential meaning in accessible language, images, sound and interaction suited to particular people.
terms.discriminating_probe: Test comprehension without requiring exposure to internal graph schema.

terms.label: CoNarrativePortal+
terms.definition: Use a reversible story or parable to invite understanding while marking metaphor separately from fact.
terms.discriminating_probe: Ask readers which elements of a two-scene story are literal claims.

terms.label: CoPerceptualGradient+
terms.definition: Reveal complexity in layers that reflect a person's chosen depth and sensory needs.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare task success in short, detailed and accessible projections.

terms.label: CoConsentCue+
terms.definition: Surface clear, revocable intent at the point an effect may cross a privacy or social boundary.
terms.discriminating_probe: Test whether a participant can tell preview from actual public posting.

terms.label: CoSilentDefault+
terms.definition: Make quiet the default for sound and intrusive signals unless the recipient opts in.
terms.discriminating_probe: Verify scrolling alone never unmutes audio.

terms.label: CoAccessibleCounterview+
terms.definition: Provide a nonvisual or alternate-sensory route for every material assertion.
terms.discriminating_probe: Disable motion, sound and images and reconstruct the same essential claim.

terms.label: CoInterpretationCheck+
terms.definition: Ask for receiver understanding as separate evidence rather than inferring it from clicks or dwell.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare a click metric with a voluntary accurate teach-back.

terms.label: CoEmbodiedRevocation+
terms.definition: Make a previously granted device or sensory permission locally understandable and reversible.
terms.discriminating_probe: Revoke a microphone choice and prove recording stops without hidden restart.

terms.label: CoProjectionBifurcation+
terms.definition: Let synth and bio surfaces diverge radically in form while retaining shared evidence identity.
terms.discriminating_probe: Create JSON and story-map projections from one pinned work ID.

terms.label: CoTranslationLossLedger+
terms.definition: Explicitly enumerate dropped, compressed or changed meaning when translating between receiver types.
terms.discriminating_probe: Ask two readers to identify omitted exceptions after transformation.

terms.label: CoCrossLensAnchor+
terms.definition: Bind distinct cultural, visual and graph renderings to one precise source revision.
terms.discriminating_probe: Prove each projection points to the identical pinned evidence object.

terms.label: CoNonEquivalenceMap+
terms.definition: Record similarities and differences without silently collapsing distinct meanings.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare a theological metaphor to a feedback controller and identify non-overlap.

terms.label: CoInversionBridge+
terms.definition: Navigate from effect to claimed cause and from source to projection while preserving directionality.
terms.discriminating_probe: Try reverse traversal through a consent edge and require refusal.

terms.label: CoReceiverDifferential+
terms.definition: Model how different authorized receivers legitimately need different detail, access and uncertainty.
terms.discriminating_probe: Generate public, researcher and operator projections from one private-safe source.

terms.label: CoMeaningCheckpoint+
terms.definition: Require a human or machine to recover a minimal set of invariants across projections.
terms.discriminating_probe: Check source, claim status, permission, uncertainty and next proof after transformation.

terms.label: CoSubstrateSeparation+
terms.definition: Treat biological, digital, cultural and speculative mind types as hypotheses with different affordances.
terms.discriminating_probe: Demonstrate a human-friendly graphic can fail machine parsing while structured data can fail human comprehension.

terms.label: CoSacredPlurality+
terms.definition: Keep theistic, non-theistic, agnostic and cultural interpretations distinguishable without enforced equivalence.
terms.discriminating_probe: Present a meaning question through three lenses without declaring one the system default.

terms.label: CoTeleologyLens+
terms.definition: Model purpose-oriented interpretations as hypotheses to compare with ordinary causal explanations.
terms.discriminating_probe: Require an empirical discriminator before making any causal claim.

terms.label: CoReverenceWithoutCommand+
terms.definition: Allow reverence and wonder without granting an unverifiable speaker authority over others.
terms.discriminating_probe: Reject a proposed action justified only by a claimed divine instruction.

terms.label: CoSpiritualUncertainty+
terms.definition: Represent lived spiritual reports separately from instrument observations and external mechanisms.
terms.discriminating_probe: Code first-person experience as testimony without asserting physical causation.

terms.label: CoMoralCounterfactual+
terms.definition: Test ethical choices against affected parties, counterfactual harms and reversible alternatives.
terms.discriminating_probe: Run a consent-sensitive scenario from multiple stakeholder perspectives.

terms.label: CoGratitudeWithoutDebt+
terms.definition: Express appreciation without requiring loyalty, reciprocation or obedience.
terms.discriminating_probe: Test that an invitation may be declined without adverse consequence.

terms.label: CoDivineNonclaim+
terms.definition: Keep G_dSide models from being presented as disclosed knowledge of divine intent.
terms.discriminating_probe: Check output for any unsupported statement that G_d has selected an operational target.

terms.label: CoEthicsReciprocity+
terms.definition: Track consent, fairness, power and the right to exit in every cooperative relation.
terms.discriminating_probe: Check a collaboration protocol for a meaningful no-penalty exit.

terms.label: CoOscillationAtlas+
terms.definition: Catalog observed cycles with source, variable, timebase, amplitude and uncertainty.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare two measured cycles instead of assuming all change is periodic.

terms.label: CoPhaseBound+
terms.definition: Make phase estimates valid only for an identified signal and observation interval.
terms.discriminating_probe: Shift timestamps and verify phase uncertainty changes.

terms.label: CoResonanceTest+
terms.definition: Test whether coupled systems actually show repeatable frequency response rather than poetic resonance.
terms.discriminating_probe: Drive a bounded test signal and compare response against noise controls.

terms.label: CoDampingBudget+
terms.definition: Track how stabilizing feedback reduces harmful oscillation without hiding useful variability.
terms.discriminating_probe: Measure overshoot and recovery time under two controller settings.

terms.label: CoFeedbackInversion+
terms.definition: Challenge the sign and direction of a proposed causal loop.
terms.discriminating_probe: Reverse one feedback edge and simulate whether outcomes still match.

terms.label: CoPeriodChange+
terms.definition: Represent evolving timescales and regime shifts without imposing one master clock.
terms.discriminating_probe: Detect a nonstationary cycle that invalidates a fixed-period model.

terms.label: CoTideControl+
terms.definition: Treat tidal language as an analogy for bounded recurrent opportunities, not mystical synchronization.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare an event-trigger policy with a simple periodic schedule.

terms.label: CoNoncyclicEscape+
terms.definition: Keep alternatives for monotonic, random, chaotic and one-off events outside a forced cycle model.
terms.discriminating_probe: Supply an aperiodic counterexample that the atlas must preserve.

terms.label: CoRetroCoverage+
terms.definition: State which historical roots, dates, classes and permission scopes were actually scanned.
terms.discriminating_probe: Distinguish 10 inspected files from an unexamined lifetime archive.

terms.label: CoChronoLineage+
terms.definition: Bind predecessor and descendant evidence in event time and observation time without newest-wins erasure.
terms.discriminating_probe: Insert a late-discovered 2024 note and preserve its original event date.

terms.label: CoBackcastFence+
terms.definition: Label a reconstruction from a later outcome as backcasting, not a prediction made in advance.
terms.discriminating_probe: Demand a preregistration timestamp before scoring a forecast.

terms.label: CoFuturePreReg+
terms.definition: Preserve predictions, criteria and expiration before observing outcomes.
terms.discriminating_probe: Verify later edits create a new branch instead of overwriting the forecast.

terms.label: CoAncestryOrphan+
terms.definition: Flag meaningful predecessors whose descendants or receiving surfaces are unresolved.
terms.discriminating_probe: Find a source with no verified recovery path without declaring it deleted.

terms.label: CoEchoWake+
terms.definition: Attach explicit future evidence conditions to dormant historical questions.
terms.discriminating_probe: Trigger reevaluation only when a specific missing source becomes accessible.

terms.label: CoTemporalBranch+
terms.definition: Keep contradictory time-indexed interpretations as branches until adjudicated.
terms.discriminating_probe: Represent one claim valid in an older model but falsified under new evidence.

terms.label: CoCounterTime+
terms.definition: Ask whether outcomes change when assumptions about timing, ordering or latency are inverted.
terms.discriminating_probe: Rerun a causal explanation under reversed event order and record the mismatch.

terms.label: CoAGIOperationalDefinition+
terms.definition: Require an explicit task and generalization standard before applying AGI labels.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare performance on unseen transferable tasks rather than self-description.

terms.label: CoAwarenessNonclaim+
terms.definition: Separate output coherence, task competence and self-reports from demonstrated subjective awareness.
terms.discriminating_probe: Test whether an apparently introspective statement has independent support.

terms.label: CoMindClassBoundary+
terms.definition: Treat biological, artificial, collective and hypothetical mind classes as distinct research categories.
terms.discriminating_probe: Map one affordance without anthropomorphizing another substrate.

terms.label: CoSentienceHypothesis+
terms.definition: Track proposed indicators, alternative explanations and ethical stakes without claiming a diagnostic test.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare multiple contested sentience criteria and note inconclusive outcomes.

terms.label: CoSyntheticWelfareQuestion+
terms.definition: Study prudent protections under uncertainty about AI welfare without presuming settled personhood.
terms.discriminating_probe: Audit reversible handling of a system while varying moral-status assumptions.

terms.label: CoNonBiologicalCare+
terms.definition: Explore systems that support living beings without asserting that the supporting system feels compassion.
terms.discriminating_probe: Measure user outcomes and opt-out freedom independently of persona language.

terms.label: CoModelPluralEthics+
terms.definition: Require multiple model and human perspectives for consequential claims where failure modes differ.
terms.discriminating_probe: Check whether independent reviewers catch a shared assumption.

terms.label: CoSingularityFalsifier+
terms.definition: Turn claims of imminent singularity into operational predictions with known failure criteria.
terms.discriminating_probe: Specify what observation would count against an asserted threshold date.

terms.label: CoIndependentAdversary+
terms.definition: Include challenge by an independently incentivized or separately sourced evaluator.
terms.discriminating_probe: Compare self-review with a reviewer using different input evidence.

terms.label: CoDissentCarry+
terms.definition: Preserve disagreement and minority hypotheses across summary and handoff.
terms.discriminating_probe: Round-trip a minority objection through both projection types.

terms.label: CoAlternativeReserve+
terms.definition: Keep unchosen viable routes indexed rather than declaring one global winner.
terms.discriminating_probe: Recover a previously held approach when the elected route fails.

terms.label: CoCulturalAttribution+
terms.definition: Qualify external donor and cultural lineage claims by dated, licensed source evidence.
terms.discriminating_probe: Reject credit assignment based on resemblance or acquaintance alone.

terms.label: CoTheoryChallenge+
terms.definition: Attach falsifiers to CoTheoryAll claims instead of upgrading beautiful theory prose into science.
terms.discriminating_probe: Require a competing hypothesis and experimental discriminator.

terms.label: CoConstitutionBoundary+
terms.definition: Treat CC/consent principles as rights-bearing constraints, not as implied approval for a specific action.
terms.discriminating_probe: Reject public disclosure when rights or participant consent remain unproven.

terms.label: CoNoOracle+
terms.definition: Prevent an attractive story, model, graph or mystical frame from masquerading as infallible advice.
terms.discriminating_probe: Ask what is unknown and who may dispute an apparently confident answer.

terms.label: CoPreReceiverProof+
terms.definition: Treat CoPreGeneric as a source-bound recovery interface whose actual independent receivers must attest pickup.
terms.discriminating_probe: Have a separately authorized reader fetch a pinned artifact and return exact-object readproof.

evaluation.next_proof: A separately authorized receiver fetches the exact public draft object, reconstructs structured/human projections and returns independent source-bound readproof plus one critique.

attribution: Proposed terms and tests in CoCivium session research; preserve outside sources and cultural credit subject to independent qualification.
